title: PLA Rocket Force purges and a possible hidden Chinese program

tellings.quote: there were some recent purges in the last few years in like the rocket forces which you know

plain: In the last few years China has purged officers of its Rocket Force, the branch of its armed forces that runs its missiles, and that shake-up might hint at a hidden Chinese programme. The researcher Matthew Pines brings this up with Michels in passing, without naming a source, and ties it to Xi Jinping's leadership. If he is right, China could be running a secret effort of its own of the kind the show discusses.
